description:
We built a small run of Great Divide Disc framesets ahead of demand and are offering them at clearance pricing while they last. Each frame has been welded, aligned, and inspected by our team in Johnstown, NY. The only thing left is the finish, which we will apply on demand once your order is placed.
The Great Divide Disc is the anchor of our lineup: crisp-handling, quick-climbing, and wonderfully stable descending and cornering, with a perfect mix of responsiveness and comfort for fondos and fast group rides. These framesets are built in our fully integrated configuration, with fully internal brake routing through a No. 22 3D-printed titanium stem, fully internal titanium headset, and No. 22 carbon road disc fork.
What's included

Titanium Great Divide Disc frame with conventional titanium seat tube
No. 22 Carbon Road Disc fork for fully internal routing
No. 22 3D-printed titanium stem (your choice of length, confirmed after order)
No. 22 fully internal titanium headset
Titanium seatpost clamp
Front and rear thru-axles

How clearance works
These framesets are built but unfinished, which lets us offer $1,200 in savings off standard pricing without compromising on anything you can see or feel on the bike. Once you place your order, we will reach out to confirm your finish selection and stem length. Most finishes ship within 2-3 weeks of ordering.
Raw is included at no additional cost. Standard finish upgrades carry the same 15% clearance discount as the frameset itself.

Customizable at no cost
Stem length. The included No. 22 3D-printed titanium stem is finished to order — we will confirm your preferred length by email after your order is placed.
Finish. Choose raw at no cost, or any of our standard finishes at the clearance upcharges above.
Frame highlights

3Al-2.5V titanium throughout
Fully internal brake routing for a clean, integrated cockpit
T47 (85.5mm) threaded bottom bracket
UDH derailleur hanger (standard hanger included)
Built for wireless drivetrains (SRAM AXS, Shimano Di2 wireless, Campagnolo EPS wireless)
Bottle bosses on the seat tube and top of the down tube
35mm tire clearance
Hand-finished welds, expertly aligned, made entirely in Johnstown, NY

Ordering and next steps
These framesets are available for immediate purchase at the clearance price shown above — one 48cm and one 52cm. Once your order is placed, we will follow up by email to confirm finish selection, stem length, and delivery timing.
